remarks: This 3.47 acre lot is situated just minutes from Ellicottville and the ski/golf resort of Holiday Valley!  Rural in nature but so close to all the shops, restaurants and entertainment the Village has to offer.  Front half is clear with a culvert in place and the back half is mostly wooded.  There are stunning views of the surrounding hills and down through the valley.  Build your dream home or your vacation home and start enjoying this great, 4-season area!  Parks and recreation along with our famous ski resorts, golfing, hiking, biking are all within minutes!  Taxes to be determined as this lot is being severed from a larger parcel.  A 3.54 acre lot is available right next to this one under listing R1662886.
